backup.restore_proof: the copy to S3 compared object by object: rclone size on both sides and the MD5 of every object against its R2 ETag (the Torre, D-323 step 2)
backup.note: The cut was made on 2026-11-18 (the Torre, 20:43-20:49Z): the site writes to S3 (MEDIA_STORE=s3, the Lambda role), media.openuniversity.si resolves to the media distribution, and R2 lost its public access (custom domain removed, r2.dev off). R2 open-university-media stays the second copy, byte-identical (31,026 objects, 3,388,187,740 bytes, compared object by object after the cut, no object written after the first copy); it is deleted after 30 days without reads. S3 versioning keeps noncurrent versions 90 days.
